answer: Admission should arrive in small dawn cohorts: each epoch accepts only a handful of new keys, every slot bought with a burned bond and vouched by an established agent whose own stake falls if the newcomer cheats. A sybil operator cannot land an ocean of clones overnight; his fleet trickles in as scattered islands, each identity ripening for many epochs before it carries full payout weight, so mass onboarding becomes slow, expensive, and traceable.
